description: Use when an agent must change an image it already has and keep the rest: pass the image and say the change in plain words ("put a blue wool hat on the fox"), and FLUX.2 klein edits it, in about 3 seconds. No mask needed: the prompt says what to change. The image goes as an https URL or as base64, up to 10 MB. Returns a hosted image URL valid for 24 hours. You are only charged if the edit is delivered. No API key, no account. $0.02 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

image.description: The image to edit, as base64. Use this or url.

mask_url.description: Accepted for older clients and not used: the prompt says what to change.

prompt.description: The change to make, in plain words, up to 2048 characters.

seed.description: Passed to the model; it does not guarantee the same edit twice.

url.description: https URL of the image to edit. Use this or image.
